results.rule_description: Hole depth-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 10:1 for standard drills
results.observation: The part is a hollow cylinder. The length of the internal bore appears to be roughly 6 to 8 times its diameter, which is under the 10:1 limit.

results.rule_description: Tapped hole thread depth >= 1.5x nominal bolt diameter
results.observation: There are no tapped holes visible on this part.

results.rule_description: Minimum internal bore diameter >= 3mm for standard boring bars
results.observation: The internal bore is a large through-hole that visibly exceeds the 3mm minimum diameter requirement.

results.rule_description: Length-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 8:1 to avoid deflection
results.observation: The overall length of the pin appears to be approximately 3 to 4 times its outer diameter, well within the 8:1 limit.

results.rule_description: Internal features must be accessible from one end of the workpiece
results.observation: The internal bore is a straight through-hole with no internal grooves or steps, fully accessible from both ends.

results.rule_description: Groove width >= 3mm for standard grooving/parting tools
results.observation: There are no grooves present on this part.

results.rule_description: All features must have adequate clearance for manufacturing tool access
results.observation: The part is a simple tube with fully accessible outer and inner surfaces.

results.rule_description: Prefer symmetric features to reduce setup operations and fixturing complexity
results.observation: The part is perfectly rotationally and axially symmetric.

results.rule_description: Horizontal holes should use a teardrop profile to prevent sagging at the top of the hole.
results.observation: This is a turned part, not a 3D printed part with horizontal holes.

results.rule_description: Functional protrusions attached to thin walls should have fillets or ribs to distribute stress and prevent layer delamination.
results.observation: There are no protrusions on this part.

results.rule_description: Lids and mating enclosures should have alignment features such as a lip, flange, or pins to ensure proper registration.
results.observation: This part is not a lid or mating enclosure.

results.rule_description: Sharp internal corners should be filleted to reduce stress concentrations and prevent cracking.
results.observation: There are no internal corners in the straight bore.

results.rule_description: Hinge knuckles must have rounded profiles concentric with the pivot pin to allow rotation without collision.
results.observation: There are no hinge knuckles on this part.

results.rule_description: Lids and doors should have a handle, tab, or indentation to facilitate user opening.
results.observation: This part is not a lid or door.

results.rule_description: Sharp external edges should be chamfered or filleted for handling safety and to reduce chipping.
results.observation: The circular edges at both ends of the pin (both inner and outer diameters) appear to be perfectly sharp 90-degree edges with no visible chamfers or fillets.
results.recommendation: Add chamfers to the outer and inner edges at both ends of the pin to remove sharp edges, improve handling safety, and facilitate assembly.

results.rule_description: Internal vertical corners must have a minimum radius to accommodate the cylindrical shape of an end mill.
results.observation: There are no internal vertical corners on this part.

results.rule_description: Holes intended for pin or shaft insertion should have a chamfered lead-in to facilitate assembly.
results.observation: The part does not contain holes intended for pin insertion; it is the pin itself.

results.rule_description: Turned parts should be rotationally symmetric; non-symmetric features require secondary milling operations.
results.observation: The part is fully rotationally symmetric.

results.rule_description: Cylindrical pins intended for floating assembly should have retaining ring grooves or other axial retention features.
results.observation: The pin is a smooth cylinder with no retaining ring grooves or other axial retention features visible.
results.recommendation: If this pin is intended for a floating assembly, add retaining ring grooves near the ends or cross-holes for axial retention.

results.rule_description: Closed-loop bearing holes intended for assembly over captive shafts must be split into two pieces with fastening features.
results.observation: This part is not a closed-loop bearing hole.

results.rule_description: Pistons must have circumferential ring grooves for sealing.
results.observation: This part is a gudgeon pin, not a piston.

results.rule_description: Thin-walled turned parts should have sufficient thickness to prevent deformation during machining.
results.observation: The wall thickness of the hollow pin is substantial and does not appear thin enough to deform during machining.

proposed_rules.pass_criteria: Ends of the pin have a visible chamfer or radius.
proposed_rules.fail_criteria: Ends of the pin are perfectly sharp 90-degree edges.
proposed_rules.description: Pins and shafts intended for insertion into holes should have chamfered or radiused ends to facilitate assembly and prevent binding.
proposed_rules.look_for: Sharp edges on the ends of cylindrical pins or shafts.
